title: Conditional Continuation and Small-Data Regularity for 3D Navier–Stokes on T³, with the Frohmanian Symplectic Tether as a Metric (Non-Poisson) Correction
description:
Expository, conditional preprint. Theorems A (Beale–Kato–Majda / Kozono–Taniuchi continuation criterion), B (Kato local existence) and C (Fujita–Kato small-data global existence) are classical results and are cited as such. The Frohmanian Symplectic Tether B(F,G) is symmetric, so it is a metric-type (metriplectic) term, not a Poisson correction; no Jacobi identity is claimed. In the velocity-slot form, B(F,H)=0. Large-data global regularity remains open; this work makes no claim to resolve the Clay Millennium Problem.
